tool.description: Add password encryption to a PDF using the standard security handler (AES-256). The returned PDF requires the password to open in any viewer. Provide the PDF as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref, a required password, and optionally a separate owner_password. Runs locally — the PDF and password never leave the device.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

password.description: The password that will be required to open the PDF.

owner_password.description: Optional separate owner password (controls permissions). Defaults to the same value as password.
